87044fae255c1139.description: The Sales Manager will be responsible for leading and managing sales operations for animal feed products, developing new business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and achieving sales and revenue targets. The role requires strong knowledge of the animal feed industry, particularly poultry and livestock feed markets. Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Identify and develop new business opportunities within the poultry, livestock, and animal nutrition sectors. Build and maintain strong relationships with poultry farms, livestock farms, distributors, dealers, and key customers. Promote and sell poultry feed, livestock feed, and other animal nutrition products. Conduct regular customer visits to understand requirements, market demand, and competitor activities. Monitor market trends, competitor pricing, customer preferences, and industry developments. Lead, supervise, and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and departmental targets. Coordinate with production and supply chain teams to ensure product availability and timely customer deliveries. Negotiate sales contracts, pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements within approved company policies. Monitor customer accounts, outstanding payments, and coordinate with Finance for timely collections. Prepare sales forecasts, budgets, performance reports, and market development plans. Coordinate with the technical and nutrition teams to provide appropriate product recommendations and customer support. Ensure customer satisfaction, resolve complaints, and maintain long-term business relationships. Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Agriculture, Animal Science, or a related field. MBA or relevant professional qualifications will be an advantage. Experience 8–12 years of relevant sales experience, preferably in the animal feed, poultry feed, livestock feed, or animal nutrition industry. Minimum 3–5 years in a sales leadership or managerial position. Strong experience in B2B sales and managing key accounts. Established network within the Saudi Arabian poultry and livestock industry will be an advantage.

8717e90cbe17d943.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Human Resources Manager to join the team in Medina. This full-time role involves contributing a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. The successful candidate will report directly to the property General Manager, with a functional reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources, and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. Key Responsibilities Execute and follow up on engagement survey related activities. Champion and build talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy. Translate business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans, and actions. Implement and sustain Human Resources initiatives at the property. Coordinate the human capital review process and lead succession planning activities. Lead the assessment of property leadership pipeline and assist with follow-up. Create value through proactive approaches affecting performance outcomes or cost control. Monitor effective use of HR systems by property managers and employees. Lead and participate in succession management and workforce planning. Serve as a key change manager for initiatives with high employee impact. Attend owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee, providing context to HR results. Supervise on-property Human Resources staff and market-based Human Resources Specialist resources as appropriate. Staffing and Recruitment Analyze open positions to balance existing talent development and business needs. Serve as a coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process. Identify opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization. Make staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property. Develop staffing strategy in collaboration with hiring managers, consulting on compensation and benefits. Monitor sourcing process and outcomes of staffing. Ensure managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff. Employee Compensation Strategy Maintain current knowledge of internal and external compensation and competitive work environments. Lead the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy. Champion the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, and policies. Participate in quarterly internal equity analysis, reviewing reports and addressing issues. Create and implement total compensation management packages/offers, including recognition and incentive programs aligned with property priorities. Staff Development Ensure completion of duties and responsibilities for property Human Resources staff members. Ensure property Human Resources staff are properly trained in all employee-related human resource information. Serve as a resource to property Human Resources staff on employee relations questions and issues. Continually reinforce positive employee relations concepts. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 4 years of relevant experience in Human Resources. The role requires considerable independence in developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business goals. A Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies will be utilized to deliver HR services that enable business success.

874f01d6f9042fd1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البيوت العصرية للديكور عن أخصائي إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم الرئيس المباشر في تحقيق الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، وتنفيذ مجموعة متنوعة من المهام الإدارية. كما يتضمن الدور تقديم الدعم لزملاء العمل الأقل خبرة والمساهمة في نقل المعارف والخبرات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة الرئيس المباشر في تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، والمساهمة في اقتراح وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات لتحقيقها. تنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الإدارية المختلفة لدعم سير العمل اليومي. تقديم الدعم والمساندة لزملاء العمل الأقل خبرة داخل الفرع أو الإدارة، وضمان نقل الخبرات والمعارف اللازمة لتطوير أدائهم. تنفيذ العمليات الإدارية والإجرائية المتنوعة لتلبية احتياجات الفرع أو الإدارة. تنفيذ العمليات والمشروعات والمبادرات المتخصصة، وتوظيف المعارف والخبرات الفنية لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء وتنفيذ المهام الإدارية المتنوعة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم للزملاء. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل الأخصائي الإداري ضمن فريق لدعم العمليات الإدارية وتحقيق أهداف الإدارة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

870abdacf300353e.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Plumber to join their team in Makkah. This full-time role involves performing a range of plumbing duties, from minor repairs and leak detection to the installation and maintenance of plumbing systems. The Plumber will also be responsible for preventive maintenance on tools and equipment, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance with safety standards. Key Responsibilities Repair minor plumbing issues, including unclogging drains. Assemble pipe sections, tubing, and fittings. Conduct water or air tests on pipes and fixtures to detect and locate leaks. Review blueprints, building codes, and specifications to plan installations. Measure, cut, thread, and bend pipes to specified angles. Install and maintain pipe assemblies, fittings, valves, appliances, and fixtures. Perform preventive maintenance on all tools and equipment. Comply with all company and safety policies, report hazards or injuries, and complete required safety training. Maintain a professional appearance, ensure confidentiality, and protect company assets. Acknowledge guests, anticipate service needs, and maintain positive working relationships. Communicate professionally and ensure compliance with quality standards. Lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 75 pounds without assistance, and assist with objects over 100 pounds. Perform tasks requiring grasping, turning, manipulating objects, reaching overhead, bending, twisting, pulling, stooping, and climbing ladders. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Execute other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors. Qualifications and Requirements Education: Technical, trade, or vocational school degree. Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience. Certifications: Stationary Engineer/Boiler Operator License and Plumber Certification are required. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, requiring physical dexterity and the ability to perform tasks in various conditions, including working at heights and handling heavy objects. The role emphasizes adherence to safety protocols and maintaining a professional demeanor in all interactions.

87748e93016641ec.description: About the Role Hilti Saudi Arabia is seeking a Project Account Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will serve as a lead solution consultant for large construction jobsites, providing end-to-end business support. The position involves professional, consultative selling, focusing on building relationships with customers to identify innovative and cost-efficient solutions. Key Responsibilities Manage assigned large construction jobsites and act as the primary point of contact from inception to completion. Develop an understanding of relevant applications and recommend appropriate solutions for specific trades. Conduct product demonstrations and articulate the value proposition of Hilti products, software, and services. Collaborate with stakeholders at jobsites to drive key initiatives. Organize seminars, product trainings, and workshops for customers to enhance awareness of new technologies and Hilti products. Address problems and challenges encountered by contractors. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of tasks. Identify growth opportunities and propose actions to improve business performance. Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships. Ensure timely coordination with the Sold-to Account Manager for account receivables collection. Required Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Company Culture and Development Hilti offers a culture that combines autonomy with teamwork, alongside extensive training, development, and career mobility opportunities. Hilti was recognized as 3rd place in KSA 2026 "Great Place to Work," providing growth opportunities both nationally and internationally. About Hilti Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with over 34,000 team members across 120 countries. The company's purpose is "Making Construction Better," driven by continuous learning, growth, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Hilti fosters an environment where team members are empowered to utilize their strengths, collaborate with a global and inclusive team, and undertake meaningful challenges. Commitment to Inclusion Hilti prioritizes inclusion in its work, leadership, and growth strategies. The company is committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an inclusive environment for everyone. Hilti continuously strives to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute, thereby strengthening teams, innovation, and overall impact in construction.

87bda17af3e682be.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إم إيه بي كونسولت للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تصميم المباني الجديدة، الإضافات، والتعديلات على الهياكل القائمة، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. يساهم الدور أيضاً في اختيار المواقع والإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. المهام الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم لمشاريع الإنشاء، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المسؤوليات مراجعة التصاميم المعمارية وإبداء الملاحظات عليها لضمان الجودة والامتثال للمعايير. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ ترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة إم إيه بي كونسولت للاستشارات الهندسية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

874d1ded1917b655.description: About the Role FHM is seeking a Curriculum Development Leader to join their team in Al Ula and Medina. This is a full-time, on-site position focused on designing, developing, and updating training curricula for facilities and hospitality management programs. The role ensures that all programs align with current industry standards and organizational objectives. Key Duties and Tasks The Curriculum Development Leader will be responsible for a range of activities essential to the creation and enhancement of training programs. This includes foundational analysis, content structuring, and material development. Conducting needs assessments to identify training requirements. Collaborating with subject matter experts to gather essential content. Planning clear learning outcomes for all training initiatives. Structuring course content and defining effective learning pathways. Developing instructional materials, guidelines, and assessment tools. Working closely with trainers to ensure effective program delivery and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Beyond initial development, the role involves ongoing oversight and quality assurance to maintain high standards for all training programs. Monitoring the effectiveness of existing programs. Integrating feedback to refine and improve curricula. Supporting accreditation processes and quality assurance requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time, on-site position based in Al Ula, with responsibilities extending to programs in Medina. The role requires direct engagement with teams and stakeholders within the organization. Company Overview FHM is dedicated to developing and delivering high-quality training programs, particularly in the fields of facilities and hospitality management. The company operates with a focus on industry standards and organizational goals.

8732ef4eba09408c.description: About Clarios Clarios is a global leader in advanced, low-voltage battery technologies for mobility. The company's batteries and smart solutions power nearly every type of vehicle, with one in three cars on the road today using a Clarios battery. With approximately 18,000 employees in over 100 countries, Clarios provides expertise to Aftermarket and OEM partners, focusing on reliability, safety, and comfort. Clarios maintains a rigorous sustainability focus, ensuring 100% of products sold are recyclable and recycling 8,000 batteries per hour within its network. Role Overview Clarios is seeking a Senior Pricing Manager META to join the team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, which serves as the META Regional Headquarters. The role involves regular travel across the GCC and Africa regions. The Senior Pricing Manager META will be responsible for developing and managing the pricing framework across various technology tiers, brands, and countries, balancing premium positioning with local market conditions. Key Responsibilities Build and operate the META pricing framework across technology tiers (SLI, EFB, AGM, xEV), brands (VARTA, OPTIMA, Delkor, Energizer, private label), and countries, balancing premium positioning with local competitive realities. Achieve the META net pricing target and protect margin per unit, in support of the META standard margin target. Ensure pricing discipline across the distributor network and channels (OEM, OES, aftermarket, fleet) to prevent grey-market activity and undercutting that erodes brand value. Establish pricing governance for the new Riyadh regional HQ, including price and deal approval rules, price analytics, and reporting, aligned with EMEA Pricing. Detailed Accountabilities Define the META price architecture: list prices, distributor net prices, OEM supply, OES, and fleet or B2B pricing, with a margin framework for each channel and price positioning by brand and technology tier. Lead the annual price adjustment process for META, including price increases in Africa and the GCC, ensuring flawless execution with Heads of Sales and Sales Managers. Manage the weekly price and deal desk: review and approve price, rebate, discount, and credit exceptions, logging each decision with its reason. Monitor competitor prices and prepare responses; utilize anti-dumping duties in the GCC for locally produced batteries in pricing cases. Manage the pass-through of lead (LME) and core prices and currency effects, especially in Africa and Türkiye, applying FX and credit rules in pricing. Analyze margin per unit and price-volume-mix by brand, technology, and country using price analytics and market intelligence; identify opportunities and present them to the Head of Commercial & BD. Design distributor terms with the Heads of Sales: rebates, bonuses, and sell-out incentives, and check compliance. Prepare pricing proposals for tenders and framework agreements with fleets, government vehicle pools, rental companies, and OEM and OES partners. Align KSA and GCC price lists after Project MIDDLE: review prices against the market across all Clarios brands. Contribute to the rollout of CPQ and price tools in META and define price data and reporting needs with Finance, IT, and the Sales Back Office; publish a monthly price realization report. Collaborate with EMEA Pricing, Product Management, Finance, and Sales; train Sales Managers on price discipline and value-based selling. Work Environment and Collaboration The Senior Pricing Manager META will be based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, at the META Regional Headquarters. The role requires regular travel across the GCC and Africa. This position involves close collaboration with various internal teams, including EMEA Pricing, Product Management, Finance, and Sales, to ensure consistent and effective pricing strategies.

87652f0f6b5a61ec.description: About KBR and the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking an Electrical Planner to join its team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time role is within KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS), which provides comprehensive solutions across the asset lifecycle, including licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, and design capabilities. The Electrical Planner will be responsible for developing and preparing maintenance plans for various activities. Role Overview The Electrical Planner will focus on preparing and developing preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance plans. These plans will be executed on a weekly and monthly basis, covering mechanical, electrical, instrument, and general services maintenance activities. The role involves ensuring proper resource allocation and coordination with various stakeholders to facilitate timely completion of maintenance tasks. Key Responsibilities Prepare weekly and monthly routine and preventive maintenance plans and all related activities. Ensure proper resource planning and sourcing for the implementation and completion of planned maintenance activities as per schedule. Analyze and record critical operational and maintenance issues related to SATORP’s equipment, plants, and utilities availability. Liaise and participate in various meetings and analyses with other Divisions regarding developing maintenance plans and schedules, providing technical inputs and recommendations as required. Coordinate with the CET Division to evaluate progress against plans and conduct technical studies to identify and recommend new practices for developing planning and implementation activities. Coordinate with all applicable Stakeholders to ensure that maintenance personnel, materials, spare parts, tools, and equipment are available and ready to perform the job. Prepare and maintain statistical maintenance and technical reports relating to routine and preventive maintenance activities at SATORP. Utilize SAP system, computer programs, and software to ensure effective implementation of routine and preventive maintenance plans. Assist in preparing, developing, and measuring Contractor’s Key Performance Indicators. Keep and maintain all historical records and databases of routine and preventive maintenance plans. Safety and Compliance Ensure compliance with all HSE rules. Encourage reporting of unsafe acts and conditions. Comply with all SHE procedures prior to commencement and during work. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this position should possess a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in electrical planning or a similar field. The role requires a strong understanding of maintenance planning principles and the ability to utilize relevant software and systems effectively. Application Process Interested applicants are invited to submit their applications for this full-time Electrical Planner position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

87cd526efe3a488f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البيوت العصرية للديكور عن محاسب تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بمحاسبة التكاليف وحفظها. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط ودراسة الأساليب المستخدمة في حساب التكلفة وتحديد عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة. تحليل عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة بشكل دوري، وتحديد معدل التكلفة المعيارية، وتحديد الانحرافات ومساهمتها في زيادة أو تقليل التكلفة. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بالتكاليف وطرق التسعير، وتقديم التوصيات للإدارة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات حساب التكاليف ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في مجال المحاسبة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بحساب التكاليف، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال محاسبة التكاليف. فهم قوي لمبادئ وأساليب حساب التكلفة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتقديم تقارير دقيقة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم التوصيات للإدارة. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات في مجال المحاسبة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل محاسب التكاليف ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم العمليات المالية للشركة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالتقدم لهذه الوظيفة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمزيد من التفاصيل.

87df171dfc443454.description: About Mace Group Mace Group integrates construction expertise with consultancy services to enhance potential across projects and individuals. The company's values guide its approach to consulting and define the professionals it seeks to join its team. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to a significant program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Opportunity: Senior Project Manager - Facades Mace is seeking an experienced project management professional for a part-time role as a Senior Project Manager - Facades in Riyadh. This position involves leading and coordinating façade package delivery for a major stadium program. The role combines package management responsibilities with direct construction oversight, focusing on ensuring effective coordination of design information, interfaces, and site delivery. It is a delivery-focused role requiring a significant site presence. Key Responsibilities Manage façade packages throughout the construction and delivery stages. Coordinate façade design information to ensure its availability for site activities. Monitor contractor progress, quality, and program performance. Manage interfaces between façade works, structural elements, and other construction packages. Identify package constraints and coordinate their resolution. Maintain a regular site presence and monitor construction progress. Coordinate contractors, designers, consultants, and project stakeholders. Monitor package risks and escalate emerging delivery issues to senior leadership. Support the planning, sequencing, and implementation of façade works. Provide package reporting to senior project leadership. Drive works towards successful completion and handover. Company Values Mace Group operates on a foundation of core values that guide its operations and team interactions: Safety first: Championing a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, with an emphasis on well-being. Client focus: Delivering on commitments, ensuring quality deliverables and strategic outcomes, and building long-term client relationships. Integrity: Influencing positive industry outcomes while adhering to compliance obligations. Create opportunity: Fostering a continuous improvement culture to inspire individual and team development. Work Environment and Culture Mace is an inclusive employer that welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. The company encourages applications even if candidates do not meet all listed criteria, as they may still be suitable for this or other roles. Discussions regarding part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options are open if suitable for the role.

87df4d5ae97ef536.description: About KBR and the Role KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the asset lifecycle, including licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, and design capabilities. KBR is seeking an Area Superintendent/Maintenance Head to manage daily operations and equipment repairs. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, and Saudi Nationals are preferred for this role. Role Overview The Area Superintendent will oversee the day-to-day activities of various support services, including the welding & fabrication shop, scaffolding & insulation workshop, and the heavy lift & rigging division. This role involves managing both planned and unplanned equipment repairs to ensure operational availability and adherence to organizational policies and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage overall department functions, providing direction to employees, conducting evaluations, and ensuring project tasks are completed within set timelines. Contribute to the development and implementation of departmental goals, objectives, policies, procedures, and priorities. Prepare, optimize, and track preventive maintenance (PM) schedules for equipment, aiming to minimize breakdowns through effective monitoring and scheduling. Oversee daily activities of support services (welding & fabrication, scaffolding & insulation, heavy lift & rigging) and manage equipment repairs. Manage the deployment of resources, equipment, and machinery to sites for routine and emergency situations. Review work plans and job request priorities to allocate resources, monitor workflow, methods of operation (MOS), and procedures, and address identified gaps. Review weekly plans and provide feedback to the Planning team to achieve schedule compliance. Coordinate with internal departments, external workshops, and OEM dealers for repairs, parts, and issue resolution. Ensure all equipment and workshop facilities are maintained to meet Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards. Conduct regular safety audits, identify potential hazards, and implement corrective actions. Recommend and schedule employee safety and technical training programs. Review daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance performance reports, timesheets, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Respond promptly to emergencies and ensure accurate reporting of all incidents, accidents, or violations. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field. Over 10 years of experience, with previous experience as a maintenance engineer in a refining environment or equivalent. Demonstrated ability to resolve problems as a leader within large organizations. Well-organized, proactive, and possessing strong communication skills. Maturity of judgment under pressure. A strategic mindset open to new ideas. Proven capacity to achieve positive results in a multicultural environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. The role involves managing diverse teams and coordinating with various internal and external stakeholders to maintain operational efficiency and safety standards.

87e4e8a5d67bbed3.description: About the Role Sinopack Search is seeking a Technical Manager Fit Out / Interiors to oversee the technical delivery of high-end interior fit-out projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves working with a Design & Build Fit-Out Contractor specializing in complex interior fit-out projects across the Hospitality (Hotels), Commercial, Luxury F&B, and Retail sectors. The role requires a technically strong candidate capable of managing technical teams and resolving complex design and construction challenges to ensure project delivery to the highest standards. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the technical and engineering department across multiple interior fit-out projects. Oversee the preparation, coordination, and approval of shop drawings, material submittals, and technical documentation. Manage technical coordination between architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, and specialist subcontractors. Review design drawings, specifications, and contractual requirements to identify technical issues and develop practical solutions. Provide technical support to project managers and site teams throughout the construction and installation stages. Coordinate with clients, consultants, designers, and subcontractors to resolve technical challenges. Oversee technical submissions, RFIs, design modifications, and approvals to maintain project programmes. Manage and mentor a team of technical engineers, architects, and draftsmen. Ensure all technical deliverables meet project specifications, quality standards, and relevant KSA regulations. Required Qualifications and Experience Proven experience working for a Fit-Out contractor or within Fit-Out delivery. Demonstrated ability to manage technical teams effectively. 8786f41b62711779.description: نبذة عن الشركة والدور TruckMate Information Technology هي منشأة سعودية تقنية مقرها الدمام، متخصصة في تطوير نظام ERP متكامل لشركات النقل والخدمات اللوجستية. يغطي النظام جوانب متعددة مثل إسناد الرحلات، التتبع المباشر للأسطول، سندات التسليم الإلكترونية، إدارة الورشة وقطع الغيار، والموارد البشرية والرواتب. تبحث الشركة عن مندوب مبيعات ميداني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينتي الدمام والرياض، بخبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. مهام الوظيفة يتولى مندوب المبيعات الميداني مسؤولية تعريف الشركات المستهدفة بنظام TruckMate ومتابعتها حتى إتمام توقيع العقود. تشمل المهام الرئيسية ما يلي: بناء قائمة بالشركات المستهدفة في المنطقة المحددة، والوصول إلى صناع القرار فيها. زيارة الشركات ميدانياً لفهم طريقة إدارتها لأسطولها وعملياتها. ترتيب وتقديم عروض تجريبية للنظام بدعم من فريق TruckMate. متابعة العملاء المحتملين حتى مرحلة التفاوض وتوقيع العقد. تسجيل الزيارات والعملاء في سجل المتابعة، وإرسال تقرير يومي مختصر. تحقيق المستهدفات الأسبوعية من الزيارات والعروض التجريبية. نقل ملاحظات العملاء من الميدان للمساهمة في تطوير النظام. المؤهلات والمتطلبات لشغل هذا الدور، يجب أن تتوفر في المرشح المؤهلات والمتطلبات التالية: خبرة في المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع النقل أو الخدمات اللوجستية أو مبيعات الأنظمة. وجود علاقات مع شركات نقل أو مقاولات أو توزيع يعتبر ميزة إضافية. رخصة قيادة سارية وسيارة خاصة. القدرة على العمل باستقلالية في الميدان. طبيعة العمل والمزايا تتميز طبيعة العمل بالمرونة، حيث يتم توثيق العقد عبر منصة قوى. يوفر الدور عمولة مجزية على كل عقد يتم توقيعه، مع دخل مفتوح بدون سقف، وحرية في تنظيم الوقت وجدول الزيارات. كما يتم توفير تدريب كامل على النظام، وحساب تجريبي للعروض، وملفات تعريفية جاهزة لدعم مندوب المبيعات. تفاصيل إضافية هذا الدور متاح بنظام العقد، ويقدم راتباً يتراوح بين 5,625 ريال سعودي و 7,500 ريال سعودي.

87bddfb49129d982.description: About the role The Senior Dealer is the operational lead for an assigned dealing shift and the first escalation point for complex trades, portfolio-risk events and client trading issues. In addition to hands-on dealing, this role directs live shift activity, monitors team performance and attendance, and coordinates cover so that dealing operations remain staffed and controlled. The Senior Dealer works closely with the Head of Dealing across three daily shifts supporting the Saudi and global markets, with particular focus on U.S. market activity. Shift leadership and staffing continuity Own end-to-end readiness, staffing, service standards and operational execution for the assigned shift; confirm attendance, desk allocation and staff availability at the start of and throughout the shift. Arrange break cover and respond to late arrivals, unplanned absence or unexpected workload; reallocate work or step in personally to fill immediate coverage gaps, coordinating with the Head of Dealing. Ensure no dealing desk or assigned shift is left unattended during required market coverage; flag forecast staffing shortfalls early and request backup support. Lead structured shift handovers, including open orders, margin actions, live risk exposures, client escalations, market events and unresolved technology incidents. Check operational readiness for Saudi and U.S. sessions, including relevant trading calendars, exchange holidays and U.S. daylight-saving changes. Trade supervision and escalation management Supervise dealers’ live order monitoring and execution quality across supported Saudi and international products, especially U.S. equities, ETFs and listed options. Handle escalated trade exceptions, complex order issues, sensitive client inquiries and broker/execution problems; execute trades directly when needed. Oversee application of buying-power, margin, concentration and trading-limit controls; prioritize material accounts and coordinate action with Risk and Compliance. Manage significant market-volatility events, options exercise/assignment concerns and urgent margin cases under approved escalation and approval frameworks. Coordinate immediate incident response for execution errors or platform disruption, preserving records and escalating critical issues to the Head of Dealing. Team performance and operational improvement Monitor shift performance, case queues, response times, control adherence and dealer productivity; provide real-time coaching and quality feedback. Support onboarding, cross-training, procedure refreshers and daily briefings so dealers are prepared for product and market-session requirements. Produce concise shift reports covering staffing, incidents, outstanding exceptions, material risks and follow-up owners. Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Client Services to reduce recurring trade-support issues and strengthen shift playbooks. CME-3 (CMA) certification and Tadawul Certificate — both required. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline; typically 5+ years of relevant brokerage, dealing or trading-operations experience. Proven hands-on experience in the Saudi market and international markets, especially U.S. equities and options; deep knowledge of the products, order lifecycle, exchange sessions and margin-risk dynamics. Demonstrated ability to lead a live trading desk or shift, supervise colleagues, prioritize risk and make sound decisions under market pressure. Strong command of OMS/trading systems, exception management, audit-quality records, stakeholder coordination and operational incident handling. Fluent professional English, written and spoken, with confident client escalation and team communication skills. Availability for rotating schedules, regular night shifts and urgent coverage when needed to maintain uninterrupted operations.

8722860751f18501.description: About the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an Advanced Yard Planner to join its Planning team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for developing strategic yard plans and optimization recommendations to enhance terminal operations. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose and Impact The Advanced Yard Planner develops forward-looking yard plans, capacity forecasts, and optimization recommendations. This involves aligning yard strategy with vessel schedules, gate demand, inventory, and equipment capabilities. The role focuses on improving planning parameters, allocation strategies, anticipating congestion, reducing re-handles, and supporting data-driven continuous improvement across terminal operations. Key Responsibilities Prepare forward-looking yard plans for vessels expected within 24–72 hours and maintain a rolling view of upcoming vessel volumes, gate demand, inventory, and available capacity. Develop allocation strategies for various cargo types, including import, export, transshipment, empty, reefer, IMDG, OOG, and special cargo, ensuring compliance with approved yard strategy, segregation requirements, and SOPs. Forecast yard utilization, block occupancy, stacking density, and capacity pressure by block and time period, identifying risks early and proposing mitigation plans. Coordinate with Vessel Planners to align yard plans with vessel schedules, stowage and loading sequences, POD, container size, weight class, and cargo-specific requirements. Design and refine allocation approaches across RTG/AeRTG/ECH and other applicable blocks, balancing capacity, equipment capability, workload, accessibility, and expected cargo flows. Analyze re-handle ratios, housekeeping moves, mixed stacks, dwell time, gate demand, and yard-related vessel delays to identify root causes and develop measurable improvement actions. Review yard planning filters, groups, ranges, stacking rules, and TOS parameters, collaborating with the Yard Strategist and IT/TOS teams to test and improve automated and manual planning processes. Develop planning scenarios for peak volumes, high yard utilization, empty-container surges, equipment constraints, and changes to vessel schedules, recommending practical contingency plans. Establish and maintain planning reports, forecasts, and dashboards to support decisions on yard capacity, cargo allocation, reefer plug requirements, and operational performance. Review long-staying containers, overstays, and empty inventory trends with relevant teams and shipping lines, assessing their impact on future capacity and recommending actions. Define and communicate yard planning standards, allocation principles, and handover requirements, supporting knowledge sharing and consistent planning practices across shifts. Support TOS upgrades, user acceptance testing, planning-system enhancements, and continuous improvement projects, documenting requirements, test outcomes, and recommended changes. Provide supervisors and management with clear analysis of capacity risks, plan deviations, root causes, proposed actions, and expected operational benefits. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in yard planning and container terminal operations. Demonstrated ability to contribute to operational excellence. Application Process Candidates with relevant experience in yard planning and container terminal operations are encouraged to apply.

87aae76499e22c52.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة وتنسيق طلبات العملاء وحجوزات توريد الخرسانة الجاهزة، مما يضمن سير العمل بسلاسة ودقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المساعد الإداري مسؤولية استقبال وتنسيق ومتابعة طلبات العملاء لضمان جدولة وتسليم الخرسانة الجاهزة في الوقت المحدد وبالجودة المطلوبة. يشمل ذلك ربط العملاء بالأقسام المعنية مثل المبيعات والمصنع والتوجيه والنقل والجودة. المهام اليومية استلام الطلبات والتحقق من تفاصيلها مثل نوع الخرسانة والكمية والموقع والموعد والمتطلبات الخاصة. تأكيد الأسعار والاشتراطات التعاقدية والحسابية بالتنسيق مع قسم المبيعات. جدولة عمليات التوريد بناءً على طاقة المصنع وتوفر الشاحنات والأولويات المحددة. متابعة الحجوزات اليومية، ومعالجة أي تعارضات أو قيود، وتحديث الجداول بانتظام. إبلاغ أقسام التوجيه والنقل والمصنع بالطلبات، ومتابعة حركة الشاحنات وعمليات التسليم. متابعة حالات التأخير، والطلبات العاجلة، والإضافات، والتأجيل، والإلغاء. تقديم خدمة العملاء، وتوفير تحديثات دقيقة، وتصعيد الشكاوى المهمة إلى الأطراف المعنية. تسجيل التعديلات والإلغاءات وإبلاغ جميع الأطراف المعنية بها. تحديث نظام الحجز وإعداد الجداول والتقارير اليومية والدورية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إداري أو ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع طلبات العملاء وتنسيق المهام المتعددة. مهارات تنظيمية وتواصل ممتازة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

87336cb1ff38c265.description: Job description Job description: Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer Job purpose: The Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation and maintenance of Envac pneumatic waste collection systems. The role supports planned preventive maintenance, corrective repairs, troubleshooting, inspections, system monitoring, spare-parts control, and customer/site support to maintain high system availability. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor Envac pneumatic waste collection systems, including collection stations, inlet stations, pneumatic equipment, electrical controls, and associated mechanical components. Perform routine, preventive, and proactive maintenance in accordance with approved maintenance schedules, technical manuals, and site-specific procedures. Envac documentation emphasizes routine, preventive, and proactive maintenance as core operational requirements. Diagnose and rectify mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control-system faults; respond to breakdowns promptly to minimize downtime. Conduct regular inspections, functional testing, and condition assessments; identify defects and ensure repairs are completed within required timeframes. Carry out authorized electrical and pneumatic work, commissioning support, and initial start-up activities in accordance with Envac procedures. Maintain accurate service records, inspection reports, maintenance checklists, fault reports, and technical documentation. Use computerized maintenance and control systems to track work orders, equipment performance, maintenance history, and service activities. Monitor and maintain appropriate stock levels of critical spare parts, consumables, tools, and materials. Support scheduled replacement of worn or failed components and recommend improvements to maintenance plans, equipment reliability, and system performance. Ensure all work is performed in compliance with Envac requirements, site procedures, applicable legislation, and HSE standards. Apply safe isolation procedures before maintenance, including isolation of electrical power and compressed air, lockout/tagout, and use of appropriate PPE. Documentation requires compressed air to be turned off before work on pneumatically operated equipment and safety switches isolated before electrical work. Coordinate professionally with clients, facilities-management teams, subcontractors, and internal operations teams; provide technical guidance and site updates where required. Participate in shift work, on-call duty, emergency call-outs, and weekend/public-holiday coverage as required by the site operation. Envac is seeking a safety-focused and technically capable Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer to support the reliable operation of advanced pneumatic waste collection systems. The successful candidate will combine hands-on electro-mechanical maintenance capability with strong troubleshooting skills, disciplined documentation, and a commitment to excellent customer service and continuous improvement. Skills Skills Required Qualifications and Experience Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Alternatively, a recognized technical/vocational qualification with relevant hands-on operations and maintenance experience. Typically 2–5 years of experience in maintenance, facilities operations, industrial automation, pneumatic conveying, waste-management systems, utilities, or comparable electro-mechanical systems. Hands-on experience in fault-finding and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control equipment. Experience with PLC-controlled systems, sensors, actuators, motors, fans, compressors, valves, VFDs, and industrial electrical panels is strongly preferred. Familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), work-order management, and technical reporting. Valid driving licence is preferred, subject to site and local requirements. Required Technical Skills Strong practical knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, P&IDs, manuals, equipment layouts, and maintenance procedures. Competence in systematic troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-up. Ability to perform inspections, servicing, adjustment, replacement, and functional testing of equipment. Understanding of preventive and condition-based maintenance practices. Knowledge of spare-parts identification, inventory control, and maintenance planning. Basic computer skills, including MS Office and maintenance/reporting systems. Knowledge of safe work practices, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout, and risk assessment. Required Personal Skills Strong safety mindset, attention to detail, and ability to follow procedures consistently. Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team. Calm and methodical approach to breakdown response and time-critical troubleshooting. Good communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage for Qatar-based roles. Customer-focused approach with professional site conduct. Physically capable of working in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, moving equipment, confined or restricted spaces, and outdoor conditions, subject to medical fitness requirements. Willingness to undertake Envac-specific technical and safety training. Envac component guidance specifies that maintenance procedures must be completed by trained personnel or personnel with solid experience handling the relevant components. Preferred Certifications Electrical authorization or electrical safety certification. NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent HSE certification. First Aid and Fire Safety training. Confined Space Entry, Working at Height, LOTO, and Permit-to-Work training. PLC, industrial automation, pneumatic systems, or mechanical maintenance certifications.

87c79fe76eba036c.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Traffic Signal & ITS Field Support Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position supports a major traffic management and Intelligent Transportation Systems program. The role involves developing and reviewing procedures, standards, and documentation for traffic signal and ITS field equipment, as well as providing technical support and quality oversight for field activities conducted by contractors and maintenance teams. Key Responsibilities The Traffic Signal & ITS Field Support Engineer will work closely with the Traffic Control Center, project technical leads, field teams, contractors, and equipment suppliers. This ensures that field work is clearly specified, consistently executed, and verified against approved standards. The role requires willingness to attend sites across the project area to observe, review, and support field activities. Develop, review, and maintain procedures, method statements, maintenance and testing protocols, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for traffic signal and ITS field equipment, including controllers, cabinets, vehicle detection, CCTV/ELV, communications, and power/backup systems. Review installation, maintenance, testing, and commissioning activities for compliance with approved standards, designs, Requests for Construction (RFCs), and as-built documentation, identifying gaps or deviations for correction. Provide technical support and guidance to field and maintenance teams, assisting in resolving operational and integration issues without performing direct hands-on work. Review controller configurations, signal phasing and timing, detector settings, and controller parameters, supporting operational improvement and network performance monitoring. Review monitoring and performance data from central management and dashboard platforms to assess field performance, recurring faults, and maintenance effectiveness. Support the planning, coordination, and tracking of field activities and work orders, following up on outstanding items to closure and reporting on status and quality. Review contractor and supplier technical submittals, drawings, test records, and commissioning documentation. Prepare procedural documentation, technical reviews, and progress and quality reports, and contribute to standards and guideline development for the program. Coordinate with Traffic Control Center operators, contractors, consultants, and equipment suppliers on procedures, field issues, and operational readiness, supporting quality control and HSE compliance across field activities. Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in traffic signal and ITS field support. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, supporting a major traffic management and Intelligent Transportation Systems program. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.
